<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try clicking all 3 purple blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
purples = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] > 10]
print(f"Purple blocks: {len(purples)}")

purple_centers = []
for p in purples:
    b = p['boundary']
    minr = min(pt[0] for pt in b)
    maxr = max(pt[0] for pt in b)
    minc = min(pt[1] for pt in b)
    maxc = max(pt[1] for pt in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    purple_centers.append((center_r, center_c))
    print(f"  Purple at ({center_r}, {center_c})")

purple_centers.sort()

# Click all 3 purple blocks
click_actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in purple_centers]
action(click_actions)

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
purples2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] > 10]
print(f"\nAfter clicking purple blocks:")
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens2)}")
print(f"Purple blocks: {len(purples2)}")

</function>
